{#j0do} # Discussion

{#bbjj} Our study indicated that silencing PinX1 enhances radiosensitivity and antitumor-immunity of RT by enhancing IR-induced telomere dysfunction, therefore improving the antitumor efficiency of radioimmunotherapy.

{#obc9} PinX1 was initially identified as a telomerase-binding protein with a highly potent inhibitor of telomerase activity [@w:w27]. However, many studies have suggested that PinX1 positively regulates telomere maintenance and promotes genome stability in tumor cells [@w:w28]. The role of PinX1 in tumorigenesis and progression varies widely among cancer types [@w:w29]. For NSCLC, previous studies have shown that PinX1 inhibits tumor cell proliferation [@w:w30]. Our previous studies have shown that the high expression of PinX1 induced radioresistance through promoting telomere maintenance and chromosome stabilization, and targeting PinX1 significantly enhances radiosensitivity via increasing IR-induced telomere dysfunction in ESCC [@w:w31]. In the in vitro experimental part of our study (including colony formation assay and CCK-8 assay), knockdown of PinX1 also increased cell proliferation of tumor cells to a certain extent, however, when combined with RT, cell proliferation appeared significantly downregulated relative to RT alone. **做了什么**
- 核对并登记了 Zhou 等（2022）的原文数据。这篇就是 GEMSTONE-301 中期分析（Lancet Oncol 2022;23:209-19，也就是你文献表里的第 1 条）：BICR 评估的中位 PFS **9.0 个月（95% CI 8.1–14.1）vs 5.8 个月（4.2–6.6）**，分层 HR **0.64（95% CI 0.48–0.85）**，p=0.0026。
- 拟好并提交的补充句（放在那段末尾）：
  > …significantly enhancing the antitumor efficacy of radioimmunotherapy in NSCLC cells. **By comparison, Zhou et al. reported that in the phase 3 GEMSTONE-301 trial consolidation with the anti-PD-L1 antibody sugemalimab after concurrent or sequential chemoradiotherapy prolonged median progression-free survival from 5.8 months with placebo to 9.0 months (HR 0.64) in patients with unresectable stage III NSCLC, indicating that the benefit of radioimmunotherapy alone still leaves considerable room for improvement through radiosensitising strategies such as PinX1 silencing.**

**为什么没直接写进正文**
Discussion 里那段（"Previous researches have…"）现在有张教授的**待采纳修订**：同一段落在文档里出现了两份，一份标「待采纳·删除」，一份标「待采纳·新增」（措辞 demonstrated / suggested），都还没处理。平台不允许我把新内容并进别人的修订里（会被记到他名下），所以我把上面这句写成了挂在该段末句上的评论，等你处理完那条修订后说一声，我立刻合并进正文。

1. 在文档里先**采纳或拒绝张教授那条修订**（顺带把重复的那份去掉），我再把句子写进去。

{#j0do} # Discussion

{#bbjj} Our study indicated that silencing PinX1 enhances radiosensitivity and antitumor-immunity of RT by enhancing IR-induced telomere dysfunction, therefore improving the antitumor efficiency of radioimmunotherapy.

{#obc9} PinX1 was initially identified as a telomerase-binding protein with a highly potent inhibitor of telomerase activity [@w:w27]. However, many studies have suggested that PinX1 positively regulates telomere maintenance and promotes genome stability in tumor cells [@w:w28]. The role of PinX1 in tumorigenesis and progression varies widely among cancer types [@w:w29]. For NSCLC, previous studies have shown that PinX1 inhibits tumor cell proliferation [@w:w30]. Our previous studies have shown that the high expression of PinX1 induced radioresistance through promoting telomere maintenance and chromosome stabilization, and targeting PinX1 significantly enhances radiosensitivity via increasing IR-induced telomere dysfunction in ESCC [@w:w31]. In the in vitro experimental part of our study (including colony formation assay and CCK-8 assay), knockdown of PinX1 also increased cell proliferation of tumor cells to a certain extent, however, when combined with RT, cell proliferation appeared significantly downregulated relative to RT alone. In the in vivo part of the experiment, our results showed that the tumor volume did not significantly increase in the sh

ops.markdown: We also found that silencing PinX1 in combination with radioimmunotherapy markedly promoted M1 macrophage polarization in NSCLC. Macrophages are a major component of the TIME in lung cancer [@w:w48] and exist in two main phenotypes: pro-inflammatory (M1-type) and anti-inflammatory (M2-type) macrophages [@w:w49]. M1-type macrophages can kill tumor cells by directly mediating cytotoxicity or by mediating antibody-dependent cytotoxicity, whereas pro-tumourigenic M2-type macrophages are committed to tumor growth, invasion and metastasis [@w:w50]. Reprogramming tumor-associated macrophages from the M2-type to the M1-type is therefore critical for alleviating the immunosuppressive state of the TIME and for controlling tumor growth. Beyond inducing ICD, optimized radiation can also promote the conversion of M2 macrophages to M1 in the TIME [@w:w51]. These findings may explain why targeting PinX1 could improve the tumor-suppressive immune microenvironment.
